rows.name:
I published another book to help sell
more of my flower encyclopedia.
Its contents were...

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0002
rows.name:
I added a story featuring beautiful
women inspired by flowers.

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0003
rows.name:
It was a huge hit with male
readers. We just can't publish
enough copies to meet demand!

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0004
rows.name:
And that managed to put me up
there as a bestselling author!

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0051
rows.name:
I bet you thought tales of
charming young men would
never sell, didn't you?

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0052
rows.name:
I wrote a passionate, aesthetic story,
and it became a huge hit with women.

rows.label: tlk4440008901_msg0053
rows.name:
I don't imagine I'd have been able to
make it if it weren't for you. I
greatly appreciate all your support!
